title: Market Operations Analyst - Gift City
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  

  

  

Be part of a new branch buildout in GIFT City and help shape how operations runs from day one. You will work across markets products and partner with regional and global teams to deliver safe, timely processing and strong regulatory reporting. This role suits a resourceful Analyst who can navigate ambiguity, solve problems quickly, and improve workflows using data, automation, and practical change.


As an Analyst in Markets Operations for the GIFT City Branch, you will support day\-to\-day branch operations across equities, foreign exchange, and derivatives while ensuring timely and accurate local regulatory reporting. You will coordinate with internal support functions and regional service providers to resolve issues, manage escalations, and maintain strong controls. You will also identify manual touchpoints, map processes, and help deliver automation and operational improvements. This role requires strong markets operations experience, sound judgement, and the ability to work effectively in a fast\-moving, buildout environment.

**Job responsibilities**

* Execute GIFT City Branch operations activities, coordinating with regional service providers to ensure consistent delivery.
* Support timely and accurate processing of equities, foreign exchange, and derivatives transactions across the trade lifecycle.
* Prepare and submit local regulatory reporting for the branch, ensuring accuracy, timeliness, and strong documentation.
* Support adoption of regulatory reporting onto strategic platforms by documenting requirements and supporting testing aligned to success criteria.
* Manage regulatory and client queries end\-to\-end within agreed timelines, escalating when required.
* Serve as a key point of contact for compliance, legal, technology, and operations partners, ensuring requests are coordinated and closed out.
* Partner across teams to deliver process mapping, data analysis, and workflow improvements that strengthen controls and efficiency.
* Identify and prioritize manual touchpoints and support improvements using intelligent automation and artificial intelligence tools.
* Prepare management information and operational reporting for internal stakeholders.

Support regulatory inspections, ad\-hoc requests, internal audits, and issue management in line with escalation and governance standards.  
* 

**Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills**

* Bachelor's degree.
* Minimum 3 years of experience in operations within financial services, including trade lifecycle support and regulatory reporting.
* Working knowledge of markets products and operations, including equities and derivatives.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to turn complex information into clear actions.
* Strong control mindset and attention to detail.
* Strong organisation and time management skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities.
* Self\-starter with strong ownership, accountability, and sound judgement.
* Ability to work under pressure, manage high volumes, and meet deadlines with accuracy.

Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to build relationships and influence stakeholders.  
* 

**Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills**

* Experience supporting a new operational setup or branch buildout environment.
* Experience using automation, workflow, or data tools to improve operations and controls.
* Experience partnering across technology and control functions to deliver process or platform changes.


**ABOUT US**  

  

  

JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.  

  

We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.

  

  

  

**ABOUT THE TEAM**
  

  

J.P. Morgan's Commercial \& Investment Bank is a global leader across banking, markets, securities services and payments. Corporations, governments and institutions throughout the world entrust us with their business in more than 100 countries. The Commercial \& Investment Bank provides strategic advice, raises capital, manages risk and extends liquidity in markets around the world.

title: Senior Business Analyst
description:
.Business Analyst

**Experience:** 3\+ Years  
**Location : Ahmedabad**  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time

Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced **Business Analyst** with 3\+ years of experience in gathering business requirements, process analysis, stakeholder management, and preparing functional documentation. The ideal candidate should be able to understand business needs, translate them into clear requirements, and work closely with technical and business teams to deliver effective solutions.

Key Responsibilities

* Gather, analyze, and document business requirements from stakeholders.
* Conduct requirement\-gathering sessions, interviews, and workshops.
* Prepare **BRD, FRD, user stories, process flows, and functional specifications**.
* Analyze existing business processes and identify areas for improvement.
* Collaborate with developers, QA, product teams, and business stakeholders.
* Convert business requirements into clear and actionable user stories.
* Support UAT, requirement validation, and issue resolution.
* Perform gap analysis and impact analysis for proposed changes.
* Track requirements and ensure alignment throughout the project lifecycle.
* Prepare reports, presentations, and business process documentation.
* Communicate effectively with stakeholders and provide regular project updates.

Required Skills

* 3\+ years of experience as a **Business Analyst**.
* Strong requirement gathering and documentation skills.
* Good knowledge of **BRD, FRD, User Stories, Use Cases, and Process Flows**.
* Experience with **Agile/Scrum** methodologies.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Good understanding of SDLC and software development processes.
* Experience working with cross\-functional teams.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Hands\-on experience with tools such as **Jira, Confluence, MS Excel, and MS Visio/Lucidchart**.

Preferred Skills

* Experience working with **SQL** and databases.
* Knowledge of API/REST concepts.
* Experience with **UAT and functional testing**.
* Knowledge of Agile tools and project management practices.
* Domain experience in **\[FinTech / Healthcare / IT / Telecom / E\-commerce]** is an added advantage.

Ideal Candidate

A proactive and analytical Business Analyst who can independently manage requirements, communicate with stakeholders, understand technical concepts, and effectively bridge the gap between **business and technology teams**.

Pay: ₹716,365\.76 \- ₹900,000\.00 per year

Work Location: In person
